description: This file defines the ComponentViewLocationExpanderProvider class, which implements view location expansion logic for Razor views in an OrchardCore application, focusing on module and page component views.

classes.name: ComponentViewLocationExpanderProvider
classes.description: Provides custom view location expansion logic for Razor views, particularly for module and page component views in OrchardCore.

methods.name: ComponentViewLocationExpanderProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider, setting up module view paths and caching.

methods.description: Expands view locations for components based on enabled modules and cached paths.
